decisions.nucleus_layout: Forty class-2 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Candidate 02 has source-relative NND 0.862, instance-count 1.487 and Ripley K24 0.697.
decisions.coupling: Added immune nuclei occupy the authorized changed tissue and interface transition; quota, seam, compatibility, spatial-distribution and local-density checks pass, with sampling score 0.898.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged, without partial-instance, overlap, border or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: The target nuclei are smaller than the source class distribution (area-p95 ratio 0.625) but remain within the frozen hard envelope. This mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality, histologic truth or clinical validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 02 as the single mask-condition handoff.
